Andhra IAS Officer Transferred After Bengaluru Pub Incident

Andhra Pradesh cadre IAS officer Vikas Marmat has been transferred from his post following an incident at a pub in Bengaluru where he allegedly abused police personnel. The transfer order was issued by the Andhra Pradesh government.
